audio_description:
A glowing energy sphere flares around the Ragnarok.
Inside its twin-seat cockpit, the stars wheel beyond the canopy.
The red ship sweeps low past a huge blue-grey structure.

context.scene_title: The Ragnarok in flight — cockpit interior and the ship sweeping past a large structure (Disc 3).
locations: In and around the Ragnarok — its two-seat cockpit (green console panels, canopy of stars) and the exterior as it passes a large blue-grey structure

characters.name: (the Ragnarok)
characters.recognition: The red spaceship, shown from inside the cockpit and outside as it banks past a massive structure amid energy.

context.summary: A glowing energy sphere flares around the Ragnarok, then the view moves inside its twin-seat cockpit looking out at the stars, before cutting back outside as the red ship sweeps low past a huge blue-grey structure.
context.context_note: High confidence the craft is the Ragnarok; the large structure it passes is not positively identified.
